about.title: About Continental Automobile
about.text: Continental Automobile is a trusted car spare parts supplier based in Kribi, Cameroon. We stock genuine and quality aftermarket parts for all major makes and models from engine components and braking systems to filters, electrical parts and accessories. Located in the port city of Kribi, we serve drivers, garages and businesses across Cameroon, Central Africa and worldwide.
